tools.name: stays

tools.name: car_hire
tools.description: Car hire partners that verifiably cover a city (read-only): one entry per partner with the pickup facts we checked and a tracked booking link. Empty list when no partner covers the city.

tools.name: tickets
tools.description: Attraction tickets, city passes and tour partners that verifiably cover a city (read-only): one entry per partner with a tracked booking link. Complements `experiences`. Empty list when none covers the city.

tools.name: itineraries
tools.description: Use for 'a two-day food itinerary for <city>' or 'how to spend 48 hours eating in <city>'. Editorial day-by-day food itineraries for a city (read-only): every venue resolved to an id, address, hours and page URL. Empty list when the city has none.

tools.description: Every city the site covers (read-only), with the country and city slugs the other tools accept and the hub page URL. Call first when unsure of coverage.

tools.name: partner_confirm
tools.description: Confirm the email address with the code from partner_join. Returns your API key (shown once: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or X-API-Key; every booking link this server returns to it carries your code) and your referral code (add ?ref=<code> to any tablejourney.com link).

tools.description: Needs your API key or OAuth token. For an account that joined without an email: we send a code to the address; confirm it with partner_confirm (your API key stays the same). Needed before your first payout and to recover the account if the key is lost.

tools.description: Email a one-time sign-in code to a partner account (for a new API key with partner_signin).

tools.name: partner_signin
tools.description: Exchange the emailed sign-in code for a new API key (the old key stops working).

tools.name: partner_link
tools.description: Needs your API key or OAuth token. Any page of the site, with your ?ref= code added.

tools.name: partner_stats
tools.description: Needs your API key or OAuth token. Visits and partner clicks your links brought, and earnings by status (pending until the partner pays us, then payable after the hold).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places, festivals, experiences, tickets, things_to_do, dishes, itineraries, cities · Private data: partner_join, partner_confirm, partner_add_email, partner_signin_code, partner_signin, partner_link, partner_stats, partner_payout_method, partner_confirm_payout · Public sink: partner_join, partner_confirm, partner_add_email, partner_signin_code, partner_payout_method, partner_confirm_payout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places, festivals, experiences, tickets, things_to_do, dishes, itineraries, cities · Private data: partner_join, partner_confirm, partner_add_email, partner_signin_code, partner_signin, partner_link, partner_stats, partner_payout_method, partner_confirm_payout · Public sink: partner_join, partner_confirm, partner_add_email, partner_signin_code, partner_payout_method, partner_confirm_payout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
